note: Hashes describe the source worktree contents read at port time; modified and untracked source files are intentionally included.

local_profile_overrides.tires.json: 13 inch nominal bead-seat rim, 280 mm outer radius and 200 mm width. Continuous carcass plus gauge-pressure radial stiffness, geometry scaling, progressive rim stop and damping ratio 0.12. Coefficients are calibration estimates; legacy coupled-world radial coefficients no longer drive hub forces.
local_profile_overrides.powertrain.json: Staged shifts: release clutch over 40 ms, synchronize input shaft with a 25 Nm bounded cone torque, engage only within 0.1 rad/s, and restore clutch capacity over 180 ms. These are configurable calibration estimates, not measured Ford data. Configurable downshift autoblip disabled in the Ford profile: torque-driven engine rev matching to the pending ratio, capped at 92 percent maximum RPM; no direct engine-speed assignment. Enabled wheel-side equivalent output-shaft compliance: inertia 0.2 kg m2, stiffness 8000 Nm/rad, damping 120 Nms/rad; implicit coupled integration. Effective calibration estimates, not measured Ford shaft geometry.
local_profile_overrides.suspension_filters.json: Activa filtros de altura, amortiguador y ARB siguiendo los rangos documentados en Rust.
local_profile_overrides.chassis.json: Ground-plane mass centres and explicit per-wheel unsprung allocations; moving masses removed from chassis.
local_profile_overrides.fuel.json: Reauthor mass centres in the active ground-plane coordinate frame; packaging estimates documented in game/docs/rally/MASS_DISTRIBUTION.md.
local_profile_overrides.steering.json: Progressive command gain and slew reduction with planar speed; full command below 20 km/h.
local_profile_overrides.suspension.json: ShapeCast3D contacts with sprung-mass frequency reference, real unsprung hubs and radial tire compliance; initial k and c preserved. Front coils unseat without clamping dampers or ARBs; attached rear leaf springs remain bilateral.
